fields.description: Tick to turn this feature on across the CRM. Untick to turn it off. Your choice survives every deploy.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The flag this one depends on. This flag cannot be turned on while that flag is still turned off.
fields.label: Requires

fields.description: The part of the CRM this feature acts on. It is set from the key, and the list of flags groups by it.
fields.label: Area

fields.description: The exact place and moment the feature runs, as it is named in the code that the flag controls.
fields.label: Trigger Detail

fields.description: What makes it run: a record save, a scheduled job, a call to or from a provider, or a permission check.
fields.label: Fires On
fields.options:
Doc Event
Schedule

fields.description: The background job this feature runs on. It shows only for features that run on a schedule.
fields.label: Scheduled Job

fields.description: The flag's name, read as Area, Subject, Behaviour. It cannot be renamed or created by hand.
fields.label: Feature Key

fields.description: What this feature does while it is on, what stands in its place while it is off, and where a user meets it. Maintained in code.
fields.label: Description
